description:
FOUND s543w (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28) by the structure-signature A/B of group BL (#5508, docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md
section 78): five of perl's own t/class/*.t (construct.t destruct.t field.t inherit.t threads.t) changed the class of
one brace, inside `method x { return $x; }`.

PPI (vendored, branch pcl-s543w):

    use feature "class"; class C { field $x; method x { return $x; } method y { 1 } }
    => ... [St Word<method> Operator<x> Constructor{ [Break Word<return> Symbol<$x> ...] } Word<method>
           Regexp::Transliterate<y { 1 } }> ...

    `sub x { ... }` and `sub y { ... }` are right (Statement::Sub, Word<x>): `Tokenizer::__current_token_is_forced_word`
    forces the word after sub / package / use / no (%USUALLY_FORCES) -- `method` is not in it, so after `method` the `x`
    is the operator (after a word, _current_x_is_operator) and the `y` a transliteration.

    Before group BL the `{` after the mis-lexed `x` was a Block by the Lexer's fall-through; after BL (a `{` after an
    operator is an anonymous hash, as perl reads it) it is a Constructor -- both wrong, because the statement is.

FIX SHAPE (on the branch, rule 13): force the word after `method` when the class feature is on (the feature tracking
of group AN knows it), as after `sub`; the Lexer then builds the Statement::Sub group AN gives `method NAME`.
NOT TAKEN by s543w: rare, and the class feature is refused (triage out).  No catalogue section yet (rule 13's section
is owed by the batch that fixes it).


=== DONE (s543w, the same batch) ===  Taken after all: group BL alone raised the expect checker's brace-class kind by
the cascades of this mis-lex (six rows in t/class/*.t), against the "no kind rises" bar.  FIXED ON THE BRANCH: group BM
(docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md section 79, registry row 79, commit eca93377): `__current_token_is_forced_word` forces the word
after a `method` Word while the tokenizer's feature set has `class` on (not after ->).  The feature is on from the line after
its `use` (the tokenizer reads a line ahead of the lexer).  Expect checker after BJ..BM: raw 149 -> 120, pcl 137 -> 108
(brace-class 14 -> 1, x-as-repetition 6 -> 0, statement-not-ended 8 -> 4, word-after-term 22 -> 16; no kind rises).
PCL side: none (class statements are refused).


=== CLOSED (the reviewing session, 2026-11-28) === merged as MAIN-READY-116 ac66f5b4 (s543w, v2-16900; PPI branch pcl = eca93377, groups BJ..BM); the full gate on merged main 380 files / 12,590 rows PASS and ROSETTA 569 of 650 with buckets 0 (~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/gate-ac66f5b4.log); the review probes ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s543/review/probes-1128/rw (five files, every row = perl: the comparisons that must stay comparisons first); no live baseline row is keyed on this task.
frequency_reason: a method named like an operator or a quote-like operator, in class syntax: five of perl's own t/class/*.t files (`method x`), no program of the board, everyday or the Rosetta corpus
subject: PPI: under the class feature `method x { ... }` lexes the method NAME `x` as the repetition operator and `method y { ... }` as a transliteration -- the statement is not a Statement::Sub (rare; PCL refuses `class` statements)
triage_reason: the 5.38 class feature is refused by PCL (Pl::Parser::feature_statement_refusal, docs/not-supported.md); the mis-lex only matters once class syntax is lowered
